parsed.explanation: Nepal has seen some political inclusion of LGBTQ people, including the election of openly gay activist Sunil Babu Pant to the Constituent Assembly in 2008. There is limited evidence of a sustained, prominent national political campaign targeting trans people. However, government action on gender recognition and inclusion has been uneven, and support from courts does not necessarily reflect politicians’ attitudes. Evidence about hostility among individual officials and local leaders is incomplete; limited documentation should not be treated as proof of its absence.
